youtube.aciklama: In loudness matching, the result is expressed relative to the threshold at that frequency, in dB SL, and in most people it is only a few decibels above threshold. One reason is recruitment: at a frequency with hearing loss, even a small increase above threshold sounds loud. So a low SL value does not mean the tinnitus is mild, and the loudness match is not strongly related to distress.
